turns.assistant:
Queue = line for work. First in, first out (FIFO).

- Work arrives → goes to back of line.
- Worker takes from front → does it → takes next.
- Order kept. No item skips.

Like grocery checkout: first person in line, first served. New people wait at back.

Why useful: work comes faster than worker handles. Queue holds backlog so nothing lost, order stays fair.
